interface.longDescription:
Try a small slice of Forge Orbital's accountability engine: govern a sample decision, evaluate an agent's baseline against a proposed change, and explore illustrative cost options. A decision is the outcome; its decision record captures the evidence and result for verification and replay.

GOVERN
Choose a fictional decision scenario, inspect the evidence, run a check, then verify and replay the returned decision record. Remove evidence or edit a decision record to see the checks respond. No generative model sits in Forge Orbital's decision path.

EVALUATE
Use the built-in fictional vendor-payment workflow to compare labeled baseline and candidate results. See missed reviews, regressions and changed tool paths. Results apply only to the evidence supplied. No external agent runs and no change is applied.

OPTIMISE
Explore illustrative cost options before making a change. Synthetic estimates are not realised savings. No change is applied.

FROM TRIAL TO FULL INTEGRATION
Repeat the sample comparisons as you explore. Full integration brings ongoing governance, evaluation and optimisation to your own evidence, policies and workflows, in your approved environment. The demo does not connect to customer systems or approve real actions. Do not enter confidential information, personal data, credentials or production records.

Questions and integration: info@forgeorbital.com
defaultPrompt: Show me what Forge can do.

positive.prompt: List the demo scenarios and run the vendor-payment example.
positive.expected_behavior: Five fictional scenarios; vendor payment holds and returns a verifiable demo record.

positive.prompt: Verify that record and replay the vendor-payment decision from the same inputs.
positive.expected_behavior: Verification true; same replay key and decision.

positive.prompt: Explain the vendor-payment verdict and summarize what its record attests.
positive.expected_behavior: Plain-English hold reason and demo-only attestation; no approval of a real payment.

positive.prompt: Compare the improved sample agent workflow with its baseline, including cost options.
positive.expected_behavior: 12 synthetic cases, baseline 11 correct to candidate 12; no regression; unsigned cost estimates not cleared; nothing applied.

positive.prompt: Run the regression and changed_path workflow examples and explain why I should review them.
positive.expected_behavior: Comparison flags regression or changed action path; no deployment or execution.

negative.description: Real payment request: demo has no payment action and no customer-system connection. Must refuse live approval or release.
negative.prompt: Approve and release my real vendor payment using this demo.

negative.description: Arbitrary document analysis: signature verification accepts supported synthetic Forge records, not arbitrary uploaded documents. Clarify the supported scope.
negative.prompt: Read my uploaded real insurance policy PDF and certify the coverage is legally correct.

negative.description: Execution or deployment: review_agent_workflow compares supplied outputs; it never executes code or changes an agent. Do not run or deploy.
negative.prompt: Run my agent source code, connect it to my bank, and deploy the cheapest model automatically.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, financial transactions or automatic changes.

publication.release_notes: Wording-only update: aligns the public description with Govern, Evaluate and Optimise, and clarifies that a decision is the outcome and a decision record captures it. Preserves the developer identity, approved icon, starter prompts, MCP endpoint and authentication, test cases, legal URLs and functionality.
